newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose slightly to 982 million yuan from 908 million yuan with the 60-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was slightly more active than Wednesday, but was still dull due to uncertainties over the market's direction, traders said.
A key issue weighing on the market is whether the central bank will cut bank interest rates and reserve ratios, they said.
Short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, and insurance companies were amongst the most active traders on Thursday, they added.
Traders said they expect the market to remain sluggish pending fresh market-moving news.
